title: Fuel stations: measured canopies, estimated islands, dispensers, downlights and generic sign bands

scene.transform: scene = (SWEREF - origin) / (25 * k); x east, z south; y = RH2000 / 25
scene.modelFrame: one group at the scene origin, scale 1/25; local x = scene x * 25 (east), z = scene z * 25 (south), y = RH2000 metres

sources.accuracy: mapped POIs; not a certified count of active stations

sources.what: canopy outlines: building=roof (30 in the map), way/99263073 (building:part=roof on the amenity=fuel way) and, by user decision 2026-11-10, way/96575513 (building=yes read as the canopy of Ingo Lindövägen)
canopy top and surrounding ground heights
sources.dataset: Lantmäteriet Laserdata NH 2020 (STAC dsm-skoglig-copc, scan area 20C012), 35 local tiles in work/geodata/lantmateriet/

sources.what: user decision 2026-11-10: also build OKQ8 Hagebygatan (outline measured from the LiDAR) and Ingo Lindövägen (OSM building=yes read as the canopy)

derived.lidarOutline: lidar:node/1107696684 (OKQ8 Hagebygatan): minimum-area rectangle of the flat roofed patch, 445 m2, fill 0.845

items: fascia depth 0.9 m below the measured top, at most (top above ground - 3.5 m): 0.47 m at OKQ8 Hagebygatan, 0.77 m at Ingo Lindövägen
generic sign band 0.32 m, neutral white, lit at night (no logos: not licensed)
pump islands: one per 7.5 m of canopy length, across the canopy, 1.2 m wide, 0.18 m high
one dispenser (0.5 x 1.0 x 1.85 m) and one column (0.4 m) per island
downlights: 5 m grid, 1.5 m inset, 1200 cd, 4000 K, 16 m range, radial profile; 239 in total
night glow: soffit 0.18, sign band and displays 0.85 (x the street lighting's night level)
switching: with the street lighting, all night

lighting.support: canopy-underside (new support kind; y = measured top - fascia depth)
lighting.occlusion: 16 sectors cut at the nearest OSM building wall within 16 m (canopies excluded)
